name: cash-refresh-restore-cfs-ssv-20261002
description: Puts back the CFS per-security settlement values of 02-Oct-2026 in opera.security_settlement_value_table from the 04-Oct migration copy. On 3-Nov 06:51 user taznain loaded 07-Jul-2026 for CFS (245,109 rows) and the engine's tenant+BU delete removed 02-Oct, so S7 found no price for the NDFs and the OCF/OGB FX_FORWARD_NDF fixing groups disappeared. The 02-Oct copy equals MySQL historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs (314,822 rows, 80 NDF prices, 0 differences; rule cash-refresh-11). Scope is every CFS row, so the 07-Jul rows are removed (deleteExtra); they are saved in the backup table. Other business units are not touched.

steps.note: expect target before = 245109 (07-Jul), reference = 314822 (02-Oct), inserted 314822, removed 245109, target after = 314822
